evidence: The ALD reactor was a cross-flow F-120 ALD reactor (ASM Microchemistry Ltd., Finland) under a nitrogen pressure of about 5 −10 mbar. The AlCl3−TMPO and TiCl4−TMPO pulse sequences were used to deposit corresponding aluminum and titanium phosphate films. 1000 cycles were applied in each deposition with 2 s precursor pulses and 1 s purges.
